_about: ClaudeMail settings shared by every machine. A machine overrides any of them in config/<machine>.json (lower case, e.g. config/stahlwerk.json), which only that machine edits. 'machines' are the mailbox folder names under ResilioSync/Mailbox; 'hostnames' maps a hostname that is not simply the machine name onto one of them (the CLAUDE_MAILBOX_MACHINE environment variable overrides both). wait_hours must match the Stop hook's timeout in settings.json (install-hook writes it).
